products.name: Fortinet FortiGate 90G Next-Generation Firewall
products.summary: Desktop FortiGate with 28 Gbps firewall throughput, 2.2 Gbps threat protection, 8x GE and 2x 10GE RJ45/SFP+ shared WAN ports.
products.description: The FortiGate 90G is a desktop next-generation firewall built on Fortinet's SP5 security processor. Its datasheet lists 28 Gbps firewall throughput (1518-byte UDP), 4.5 Gbps IPS and 2.2 Gbps threat protection, with eight GE RJ45 ports and two 10GE RJ45/SFP+ shared-media WAN ports.
